title: Health Decision Workshop — 45m playbook for strategic accounts
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, decision-focused 45 minute workshop playbook for strategic renewal conversations. The goal is not to review every metric — it's to surface a decision (renew / expand / pause / require remediation) and align a short list of concrete actions, owners, and timing before the renewal window.

When to use this:
- Mid- to late-stage renewal (60–90 days out) where signals are mixed or leadership alignment is required.
- High-ACV accounts where one or two blockers determine renewal outcome.
- When multiple stakeholders need to converge on a specific ask (e.g., commit to an adoption plan or approve budget).

Attendees (suggested):
- Customer Success Lead (facilitator) — 1
- Customer exec sponsor — 1–2
- Product/Technical lead (CS or customer side) — 1
- Solutions/AE (if renewal/expansion pending) — 1
- Optional: Customer IT/security for private deployments — as needed

Logistics checklist (pre-meeting, 7–3 days before):
- Pull adoption dashboard + usage trends (30/90/180d). Link: <adoption-dashboard-placeholder>
- Extract top 5 customers KPIs and 3 anomalies (errors, latency spikes, feature drop-offs).
- Confirm renewal window and contract owner (Sales) — add to invite.
- Share 2-page pre-read with customer 48h before: one-page snapshot + 1-page proposed decision framing.
- Internal run-through (15m) with AE/Product to align ask/tone (24h prior).
- Create a shared decision ledger doc and add to invite (title: ACCOUNT — Health Decision Ledger).

45m Workshop agenda (scripted timings + facilitator cues):
- 0:00–0:05 — Kickoff & goal setting (Facilitator)
  - Script: “Thanks everyone for joining. We have 45 minutes. Objective: surface the decision we need to make for the upcoming renewal and agree on owners and a clear 30/60/90 day action plan. I’ll keep us on time and capture decisions in the ledger.”
  - Boundary: no new technical deep-dives — we capture action items for separate follow-ups.

- 0:05–0:15 — Customer priorities & changes (Customer exec + Prod lead)
  - Ask customer to state top business priorities for the next 12 months (2–3 bullets).
  - Prompt: “Which outcomes from our platform are mission-critical versus nice-to-have?”
  - Facilitator note: Capture any budget/timing constraints they mention verbatim in ledger.

- 0:15–0:25 — Health signals and interpretation (CS lead presents)
  - Present 3 core health signals (usage, latency/errors, engagement with key features) — 2 slides / 3 minutes each max.
  - Script: “Here’s what the data says; here’s our interpretation and the risk/growth levers we see.”
  - Highlight: any recent regressions or improvements tied to releases or infra changes.

- 0:25–0:35 — Decision framing & options (Facilitator + AE)
  - Present 3 options (recommended option first): Renew-as-is, Renew-with-conditions (adoption milestones), Pause/Remediate.
  - Script: “Given priorities and the signals, here are the options we recommend. Which aligns with your needs?”
  - Use decision criteria: business impact, technical risk, timeline, budget.

- 0:35–0:42 — Risk mitigation and commitments (all)
  - Capture explicit commitments from both sides (owner, deliverable, due date).
  - Examples: Product to deliver integration guide by 2/28 (Owner: Eng Solutions).
  - If remediation required: agree to an SLA for fixes and a gating metric threshold.

- 0:42–0:45 — Recap & next steps (Facilitator)
  - Read back the decision and 30/60/90 plan. Confirm owners and dates. Confirm follow-up meeting (e.g., 30d checkpoint).
  - Script: “To confirm: decision = <X>. We’ll capture tasks in the ledger and send a one-page summary within 24 hours.”

Facilitation playbook (phrases, nudges, de-escalation):
- If conversation stalls: “Let’s anchor to the business outcome — would that deliver the ROI you described?”
- If tech conversation goes deep: “We’ll capture the technical action and set a follow-up with product/engineering. Can we park that deep-dive for a 30m tech session?”
- When customer is non-committal: present a binary ask — e.g., approve pilot expansion to two teams on a 60-day milestone.
- When customer asks for discounts: ask for proportional commitments (higher commitment -> tiered discount). Capture in ledger and loop in Sales.

Decision ledger (what to capture — template lines to paste into doc):
- Decision: <renew|expand|pause|remediate>
- Rationale (1–2 bullets)
- Owner(s) and fallback owner
- Deliverable / gating metric (with measurement method)
- Due date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Escalation path (name + email / Slack)

Pre-meeting data pulls (detailed):
- Usage: top 10 active features by seat count; avg daily active users; cohort retention 7/30/90d.
- Financial: ARR by product line, churn risk estimate, expansion leads in pipeline.
- Reliability: 30/90d error rate, recent incidents, average P95 latency (linked to region).
- Support: open tickets by severity, avg time-to-resolution, escalations.
- Qualitative: top CSM notes (last 4 interactions), exec emails referencing blockers.

Store these in the pre-read appendix — keep the main workshop to 1–2 slides + decision framing.

Post-meeting follow-up templates (send within 24 hours):
Subject: Recap + Decision — <Account name> — <Decision short label>
Body bullets: decision, 30/60/90 owners/dates, immediate blockers, scheduled 30d checkpoint (date/time), attached: one-page summary + ledger link.

Escalation & contingency flows (if metrics worsen after workshop):
- If key gating metric deteriorates by >20% within 14 days -> automatic escalation: SRE/Eng on call + CS leadership sync.
- If customer requests pause on renewal: move to remediation track and require weekly status updates until metrics show recovery.

Signals that typically flip a renewal (heuristics we use):
- >25% drop in core-feature adoption month-over-month + no mitigation plan.
- Two or more Sev2 incidents in 30 days affecting integration.
- Exec stakeholder change with unclear successor and no committed adoption owner.
- Noticeable plateau in trial-to-paid conversion in segments tied to the renewal.

Notes-to-self section (facilitator hacks):
- Start meeting on the minute (0:00) — signals professionalism and keeps exec time.
- Use short, decisive framing language: recommend -> explain -> ask for decision.
- Keep slides minimal: 1 slide for outcomes, 1 slide for signals, 1 slide for options.
- Bring the ledger link into the meeting chat immediately after the decision.

Open questions / follow-ups for internal team:
- Do we need a renewal discount playbook tied to adoption milestones? (Action: Priya to draft)
- Can product commit to a 30d integration support SLA for strategic accounts? (Action: Jonas to confirm with Eng)

Quick checklist (copyable before every workshop):
- [ ] Invite contains pre-read link + decision ledger + 45m agenda
- [ ] AE + Eng included or confirmed standby
- [ ] Adoption dashboard updated (90/30/7d)
- [ ] Support tickets and incident postmortems attached (if any)
- [ ] Internal 15m prep run completed
- [ ] Shared doc created: ACCOUNT — Health Decision Ledger

Appendix (examples of short pre-read one-pager):
- Header: Account name, renewal date, ARR, contract owner.
- One-line exec summary: recommendation + top risk.
- 3 health signals: metric, trend, implication.
- 1-line ask (what we want them to decide).

——END——

AUTHOR NOTES: This is intentionally concise and biased toward forcing a binary outcome. Keep the tone consultative, not combative. We will A/B two versions: (A) Remediation-first (more conservative) and (B) Growth-first (assume renewal and push expansion milestones). Track which version used for learning.
